trends.name: Iran Military Escalation & Ceasefire Plans
trends.summary: Trump confirmed a 2-3 week plan to end Iran operations in Wednesday address, with military officials planning potential high-risk ground assaults pending presidential approval. Simultaneous ceasefire talks with Saudi Arabia and Ukraine negotiations signal complex geopolitical realignment. This directly impacts Middle East tensions, oil prices, and gold.

trends.name: Gold Surge & Inflation Expectations
trends.summary: Gold futures surged above $4,800/oz, up $720 since March 23 low, adding $3 trillion in market cap. ISM prices paid index jumped to 78.3 in March (highest since 2022), signaling new inflation regime driven by tariffs, steel/aluminum costs, and Middle East oil shocks. Investors rotating into hard assets.

trends.name: Oil & Strait of Hormuz Supply Risk
trends.summary: UK hosting coalition talks to reopen Strait of Hormuz while Iran asserts sole control over the waterway. Iran operations could disrupt 30% of global seaborne oil. Oil prices priced in elevated risk amid Middle East uncertainty extending conflict duration.

trends.name: Tech Stock Valuation Reset
trends.summary: Tech stocks haven't been this cheap versus S&P 500 in six years; Microsoft upgraded at 22x P/E as buying opportunity. Sector rotation and AI capex spending driving selective strength despite broader market volatility and rate whipsaws.

trends.name: SpaceX IPO Filing & Space Economy
trends.summary: SpaceX confidentially filed for IPO, setting stage for record offering. Major catalyst for space/satellite/defense investing and signals confidence in commercial space economy despite geopolitical tensions.

trends.name: Crypto & Digital Assets Mainstream Push
trends.summary: Franklin Templeton acquires digital assets investment firm, signaling major institutional push into active crypto management. Reflects growing mainstream acceptance and institutional demand for digital asset exposure.

trends.name: Semiconductor & Chip Sector Strength
trends.summary: Intel jumps 10% after buying back Ireland chip fab in sign of renewed strength; Micron stock hits biggest gain in a year with record market-cap boost. Data center capex ($2.5T) and grid rebuild driving semiconductor demand despite macro uncertainty.

trends.name: Retail & Luxury Sector Weakness
trends.summary: Nike turnaround stalls with China weakness deepening; RH stock plunges as ultrarich consumers pull back on home spending. Consumer discretionary weakness signals demand concerns amid inflation and rate uncertainty.

trends.name: Corporate Layoffs & Labor Market Softening
trends.summary: Oracle initiating layoffs to assist cost savings; overall job market showing layoffs closer to drought than deluge. Signals labor market remains resilient but corporate profitability pressures mounting amid cost inflation.

trends.name: Treasury Yields & Housing Market Volatility
trends.summary: Whipsawing rates threatening spring home-buying season; $4/gallon gas prices create stagflation psychology. Rate volatility cooling real estate demand and mortgage refinancing activity at critical threshold.

trends.name: Pharma & GLP-1 Drug Market Expansion
trends.summary: FDA approves Eli Lilly's GLP-1 pill, opening next phase of weight loss drug market; Eli Lilly opposes Trump's drug pricing deals. Major market opportunity in oral GLP-1s but facing regulatory headwinds and political pricing pressure.

trends.name: Geopolitical NATO & Defense Realignment
trends.summary: Trump signals consideration of pulling U.S. out of NATO as 'paper tiger,' reshaping Cold War alliance structure. Defense spending, European defense budgets, and security dynamics face fundamental shifts affecting military contractors and NATO members.
